migrations.description: Baseline inicial de contratos API y schemas Zod.
Alinea el contrato de actualización de usuario con avatarUrl compartido.
Align offline payload contracts with JSON-safe shared types and exported AI response schemas.
Refresh generated API contract snapshot after exposing current shared schemas.
Align generated API contract snapshot formatting with the repository Biome configuration.
Emit canonical English role values while keeping legacy role inputs normalized at boundaries.
Fix TypeScript errors in costs module - getCostDashboard method, resolveLineDeltaStatus types, hasCosts field.
Replace legacy Spanish order contract fields and selected snake_case persistence fields with canonical English camelCase names.
Rename all Spanglish enum values to canonical English across execution phases, activity types, inspection types, and kit categories.
Remove legacy execution phase and status aliases and omit absent execution phase timestamps from the public order contract.
Expand OrderStatus enum to 16 values covering the full FSM pipeline (proposal, planning, billing stages). Add FSM transitions, terminal/active/editable state sets, and kanban column mappings.

Complete implementation of the CERMONT FSM pipeline. Includes dynamic personnel assignments, kit availability checks, backend safety verification synchronization, enhanced dashboard metrics, and catalog management for checklists and report templates.
Refresh contract snapshot after monorepo workspace and dependency recovery.
Expose maintenance kit customFields for tools and equipment so planning kits can preserve user-defined field values.
Normalize CreateProposalInputSchema Spanish field names (cliente, descripcion, valorEstimado) to canonical English (client, description, estimatedValue).

Extend OfflineEntityTypeSchema from 3 to 10 types to support full offline sync for work-request, site-visit, checklist, evidence, planning-packet, cost, delivery-record, service-entry-sheet, invoice, and payment entities.
Add discriminated union schemas for offline sync operations (work-request, site-visit, planning-packet, execution-session, evidence) with typed payloads + uuid id field.

Introduce FileAsset contract (FileAssetRef, FileAssetUploadInput, FileAssetUploadResponse) with category, sync status and entity type taxonomies, plus mime allowlist (jpeg/png/webp/gif/pdf) and category presets. Supports file/image assets for kits, tools, equipment, materials, evidences, before/after photos, signatures, delivery records, technical reports, cctv, life-line, planning, checklist evidence and report covers.

Add FileAssetUploadInputFormSchema for multipart form validation (accepts tags as string or string[] and coerces to string[]) and CreateFileAssetResultSchema for the service-layer return value of createFileAssetFromUpload. The form schema is used as a route-level validateBody middleware on POST /api/files/upload so the controller can rely on req.body being already validated and coerced.
Add image (single FileAssetRef) and gallery (array of FileAssetRef) fields to KitItemSchema and ToolSchema for support of item-level images in kits and tools/equipment/materials.
Align FileAsset contract with Phase 42 implementation by adding safety item images, signed documents, safety_item entity ownership, and synced/pending/failed sync statuses.

Extend PlanningPacket contracts with CERMONT planning form fields for inspector, place, date, business unit, scope, materials, safety elements, worker requirements and responsible signatures. Expands planning support document types for ATS/PTW/procedures and certification evidence.
Refresh the API contract snapshot after aligning shared role schemas with the CERMONT operating roles and status-object absence semantics emitted by current shared schemas.
Normalize the Auxiliar HES role value to lowercase auxiliar_hes so shared RBAC validation, role normalization and generated contracts use a single canonical representation.

Extend offline sync contracts with modern outbox items, batch ids, item-level sync results, conflict metadata, file metadata and typed JSON payloads while keeping legacy operation support for existing queues.
Require support evidence or documents for actual cost entries and expose cost record status plus void metadata so historical costs are voided instead of physically deleted.
Add ApplyPlanningKitSchema and its type to support applying typical kits to planning packets.
Add CostBaselineSnapshotSchema to planning packets and fix contract serialization with optional object defaults.
Add Colombian DIAN fields to Invoice schema and extract modular sub-schemas for ExecutionSession.
Add SES_NOT_APPROVED_BEFORE_INVOICE and INVOICE_NOT_APPROVED_BEFORE_PAYMENT blocker codes for cross-step administrative closure validation.
Add master data schemas (client, site, equipment, material, epp, camera, lifeline).
Add Wave 4 commercial feature schemas (contract, inventory-item, schedule-event).
Add MISSING_KIT_CRITICAL_ITEMS blocker code and normalize 14 step domain semantics (ses_approved step).
Add serviceCaseId to WorkRequest schema for step-context inheritance chain (Lote 1-1). Add ServiceCaseStepContext schema with InheritedField, FieldOverride, CanonicalCaseData contracts.
Regenerate contract snapshot after build — captures accumulated schema changes including step-context contracts and WorkRequest serviceCaseId field.
Add serviceCaseId to CreateProposalSchema to fix 400 error when creating proposal with linked service case.
Export ServiceCaseStepContext schemas from shared-types barrel so StepContextQuerySchema is available at runtime.
Regenerate contract snapshot after fixing getTransitionEvent state mapping in service-case state machine.
Add title field to CreateEvidenceSchema and EvidenceSchema for per-photo descriptive titles.
Add daysInCurrentStep integer field to ServiceCase contract for KPI tracking.
Add InvoiceApproval and ClientSignature schemas, enhance Notification schema with multi-channel, add FSM engine.
Export Client schema from barrel and extend it with city, industry, contracts, Update/ListQuery DTOs for the CRM module.
Export AST (safety analysis) schemas from barrel with Update/ListQuery/Sign DTOs and FSM transition map for the digital AST module.
Add certifications and skills to the User contract with Add/UpdateSkills DTOs for the personnel certification matrix.
Export inventory item and stock movement schemas with Create/Update/Movement/ListQuery DTOs for the inventory module.
Add Vehicle schema with Colombian document expiries (SOAT, tecnomecanica, poliza), Create/Update/ListQuery DTOs and document alert contract for the fleet module.
Add analytics report, dispatch, SLA, system configuration, reminder, and DIAN contracts; extend invoices with explicit DIAN lifecycle fields.
Persist structured conflict details on offline outbox items for DLQ inspection and explicit user-driven resolution.
Add typed audit response contracts, entity and request correlation filters, expanded audit actions, and shared workflow step-to-stage metadata.
Broaden audit entityId validation from MongoDB ObjectId to general entity identifier pattern; add DIAN, dispatch, SLA, and system-config schema contracts for production wave 5.
Add BusinessDocument and ErpConnector schemas for multi-ERP abstraction and document-driven template engine.
Add CreateMaintenanceScheduleSchema/UpdateMaintenanceScheduleSchema and ScheduleFrequencyEnum for the Spec 008 maintenance schedule CRUD endpoints.
Regenerate contract snapshot after evidence controller fix exposes EVIDENCE_REJECTED audit action in generated contracts.
Add PASSKEY_REGISTERED audit action and WebAuthn credential schemas for WebAuthn/Passkey authentication support.
Regenerate contract snapshot after Spec 007 schema changes (Vehicle, FileAsset, Fleet extensions).
Extend FileAsset ownership, lifecycle metadata, audited downloads, and canonical list query contracts while retiring the duplicate media API.

Add isBlocking, requiresPhoto, requiresSignature fields to ChecklistItemSchema. Add fsmStatus, rejectionReason, replacedBy, replaces fields to EvidenceSchema for evidence FSM workflow (captured→uploaded→verification_pending→verified|rejected→replaced).
Regenerate contract snapshot after Biome lint formatting fix and Fleet/Tool/Evidence/Checklist schema extensions.
Add RecordCalibrationSchema, ToolUsageSchema, and CalibrationsDueQuerySchema for tool calibration and usage tracking endpoints.
Add DashboardMaintenanceEfficiencySchema (MTTR/MTBF/completion rate) as optional dashboard summary section and NotificationPreference schemas for per-user notification channel settings.

Add CreateCostCatalogItemSchema for POST /costs/catalog, PlanningReadinessReportSchema (canExecute + blockingReasons) for GET /planning-packets/:id/readiness, and optional KitItem fields isBillable/catalogItemId/returnRequired linking kits to the cost catalog.
Add DashboardSlaRiskOrderSchema and slaRiskOrders (default []) to DashboardSummarySchema so the dashboard lists active cases that are overdue or within 72h of their promised completion date.

Spec-015 SSOT enrichment: add ServiceCaseCockpit (14-step progress), cost catalog create/list DTOs, BaselineCost, CostIntelligenceSummary, PreflightChecklist, FieldNovelty, EvidenceSlot(s), KitSafetyRequirements and DashboardOperationalKPI schemas; add replacement_requested evidence status, preflight/SLA execution blockers, and optional SLA-risk-order enrichment fields.
Add optional literal search by cost catalog item name or code to GET /costs/catalog.
Spec-016 Sprint 0: refresh API contract snapshot after Spec-014/015 accumulated changes.
Add KPI schemas, automation-rule schemas, DashboardKpiWidget.
Add QR code schema for generating scannable QR codes by entity type (order, service_case, equipment, tool, vehicle).
Add slaHours field to WorkRequest schema for SLA tracking.
Add form submission, ERP sync, jobs action, ERP mapping, and bulk QR request schemas for route-boundary validation.
